description: Save local relationship context for one contact. This does not modify Apple Mail or contact the person.

follow_up_at.description: ISO-8601 date/time for a human-approved follow-up reminder.

relationship.description: For example: prospect, client, partner, or colleague.

tone.description: For example: concise and direct, or warm and detailed.

user_approved.description: Must be true only after the user approved saving this local contact context.

name: save_contact_context
